# Arira AI

> Implement AI That Saves & Makes Money. Arira AI runs a 100 Day AI Journey inside companies: Discover, Build, Handover. 100+ KPIs delivered via 50+ Agentflows. Every agent and line of code stays with the client.

## Facts
- Contact: care@ariraai.com
- Model: fixed fee plus a share of the value found. No value, no share.
- Agentflows run inside the client’s systems and accounts.

## For agents
- [Agent index](https://ariraai.com/for-agents): what Arira AI does, how engagements work, results
- [KPIs](https://ariraai.com/for-agents/kpis): the KPIs shown on the site and the Agentflows that move them
- [Agentflow catalogue](https://ariraai.com/for-agents/agentflows): every Agentflow, inputs, outputs, KPIs
